title: `CLIEngine#getFormatter()` is no longer a static function- throws an error

labels.name: core
labels.description: Relates to ESLint's core APIs and features

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
`CLIEngine.getFormatter` used to be available as a static function.
It's also mentioned in [the docs](http://eslint.org/docs/developer-guide/nodejs-api#getformatter) that it's "available as a static function".
Since the introduction of the CLIEngine `cwd` option this is no longer the case since it calls `this.options.cwd` internally and `options` is undefined (because `options` is set with `defaultOptions` in the constructor which isn't called).

My use-case that made me encounter this is trying to use a custom formatter. I use `grunt-eslint` which calls `getFormatter` as static internally and passes a string as the argument, which means I expect it to infer it as a relative path which needs to concatenated to the current working directory.
Previously the cwd was resolved by calling `process.cwd()` and now it's resolved by calling `this.options.cwd` which as I mentioned is now undefined.
- **The version of ESLint you are using** 2.2.0
- **What you did** Call `getFormatter` as static and pass a path of a custom formatter as the argument
- **What you expected to happen** No error thrown. A custom formatter is returned.
- **What actually happened** Error: `Cannot read property 'cwd' of undefined`
- **The source code line that's causing the error** [here](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/2bd57b6bbd11b23fdec65dc11c691f74c6a8db75/lib/cli-engine.js#L407)

**My configuration**

ESLint

```
{
    "ecmaFeatures": {
    },
    "rules": {
        "no-func-assign": 2,
        "no-delete-var": 2,
        "no-implicit-globals": 2
    }
}
```

grunt-eslint

```
eslint: {
    teamcity: {
        src: ['blabla/**/*.js'],
        options: {
            format: 'node_modules/eslint-teamcity/index.js'
        }
    }
}
```

**Output**

Running "eslint:teamcity" (eslint) task
Verifying property eslint.teamcity exists in config...OK
Files: blabla/yetayeta.js
Options: outputFile=false, quiet=false, maxWarnings=-1, format="node_modules/eslint-teamcity/index.js"
Warning: Cannot read property 'cwd' of undefined Use --force to continue.

**References**
- This is the issue that added the CLIEngine `cwd` option #4472
- This is the issue and pull request that made `getFormatter` static initially #3239.
- This is the issue I initially opened at `grunt-eslint` which uses `getFormatter` as a static method sindresorhus/grunt-eslint#109

Thank you!
